title: Make model and effort explicit per role; escalate hard producer jobs
summary: Config names model and effort for the reader, producer and verifier. Both reach the claude driver and are recorded on every invocation record. A reading that judges a job hard picks a stronger producer model or higher effort, with the reason recorded. athena status shows first-pass verification rate, landed share and cost per landed job by producer model and effort. Audience: the Athena owner tuning quality. Planner and critic are dropped from scope because planning is off.

defaults_applied.how: Tests added for each behavior; cargo test and clippy are clean.
Criteria check the driver arguments, the escalation and the status output, not just that fields exist.
Status handles buckets with zero landed jobs explicitly.
Config validation rejects unknown effort values.
Decision and changelog entries are written for an outside reader.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Planner and critic roles are out because job planning is off (f80b05a); only reader, producer and verifier are configured.
The reading output gains a hard flag and reason field; the escalation picks the producer model or effort from a configured hard setting.
Effort values are a closed set matching the CLI's levels; the exact list comes from the claude driver's supported flag.
Existing records stay loadable via optional fields.

acceptance_criteria.text: A test (cargo test) shows the configured model and effort for each role reach the claude driver as CLI arguments and appear on that invocation's record.

A test (cargo test) shows a reading marking a job hard gets the stronger producer model or effort with its reason recorded, while an ordinary reading keeps the configured default and records no escalation reason.

A test (cargo test) shows athena status output lists first-pass verification rate, landed share and cost per landed job per producer model and effort. A bucket with no landed jobs shows no division by zero and no false success.

athena.toml (listed as a deliverable) sets model and effort for reader, producer and verifier, plus the hard-job producer setting. config.rs parses them and rejects unknown effort values. Older records without effort still load.

CHANGELOG.md has an entry that notes request 20261013-042934-a1j8 is absorbed. docs/decisions.md records the decision with alternatives, including dropping the planner/critic roles because planning is off.
cargo test, cargo clippy and cargo fmt --check pass.

out_of_scope: Planner and critic roles (planning is off)
departures: Touches eight files across several crates with new status measures, so cost and time sit above the reference.
